items.title: Eiji Kitamura interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999
items.q: And once at the Monterey Jazz Festival he called me on stage and we played together.

ctx.x: Tell me about, you played with Woody Herman?

Yes. Woody was very sweet to me. It was very funny, when I came to the Monterey Jazz Festival, I met Stan Getz and Stan Getz, he asked me, “Eiji, do you know Woody Herman?” “Yes, of course, but only know Woody Herman’s record and many times on stage, but don’t talk to each other.” “Okay, I’ll introduce you.” And Stan introduced me to Woody Herman. Woody is very — his personality is marvelous personality. I mean he has a very good heart and then Woody told me about sometimes playing double clarinet, and you play…
